quality_checks.name: KL and top-1 agreement
quality_checks.what: Greedy logprobs old against new config, same GGUF, cuts of 2k-100k tokens
quality_checks.threshold: Compare with the noise floor: KL 0.0002, top-1 99.6 %

quality_checks.name: Needle in a haystack
quality_checks.what: Planted code in filler text, 16k to 250k tokens, room left for thinking
quality_checks.example: Stock SGLang needles at 100k, 150k, 190k on two of three builds

quality_checks.name: Digit-copy probe
quality_checks.what: Copies digit strings in long prompts and finds two needles
quality_checks.example: Maya 1.0.4 split one string; 1.1.11 copied 12 of 12

quality_checks.name: Tool-call probe
quality_checks.what: One function call with arguments, parsed
quality_checks.example: Passed on every engine until tqLLM's first failure

quality_checks.name: Multi-session probe
quality_checks.what: 11 checks: parallel answers, two decoding together, tool calls, long plus short, five concurrent
quality_checks.threshold: 11 of 11 (10 of 11 at one slot, by design)
quality_checks.example: llama.cpp live 11 of 11; tqLLM 3, 0 and 4 of 11

quality_checks.name: Real agent tests
quality_checks.what: Tests 1 to 8; the only check that sees what an agent does
quality_checks.example: Gyro-S + MTP test 2: full pass in 24 minutes

quality_checks.name: Grader audits
quality_checks.what: Regrade old runs when a grader changes
